# Credit for the Google fixtures

The `.json` and `.txt` files in this directory are response examples from the Google Maps Platform documentation for the Geocoding API and the Places API.
Portions of those pages are reproduced from work created and shared by Google and used according to terms described in the Creative Commons 4.0 Attribution License.
The licence is at https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/.

The `.json` files are unchanged.
The `.txt` files are examples the documentation shortens with elision marks, kept as printed, and the tests strip the marks when they load them.

The fixtures of every other provider in `test/fixtures` are synthetic.
They follow the provider's documented response shape, and every value in them is made up.
